===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:ende}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₂ent-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|ende}}, from {{inh|en|ang|ende}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*andī}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*andijaz|t=end}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro|*h₂entíos|t=forehead; front}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*h₂ent-|t=face; forehead; front}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*h₂en-|t=on, onto}}.
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|yol|een}}, {{m|yol|eene|t=end}}, {{cog|stq|Eend}}, {{m|stq|Eende|t=end}}, {{cog|fy|ein|t=end}}, {{cog|gsw|End}}, {{m|gsw|Endi|t=end}}, {{cog|gmw-cfr|Eng}}, {{m|gmw-cfr|Enk|t=end}}, {{cog|cim|énte|t=end}}, {{cog|nl|eind}}, {{m|nl|einde}}, {{m|nl|end|t=end}}, {{cog|de|Ende|t=end}}, {{cog|lb|Enn|t=end}}, {{cog|wym|end}}, {{m|wym|ent|t=end}}, {{cog|da,nb,nn|ende|t=end}}, {{cog|fo|endi|t=end}}, {{cog|is|endi}}, {{m|is|endir|t=end}}, {{cog|sv|ända}}, {{m|sv|ände|t=end}}, {{cog|got|𐌰𐌽𐌳𐌴𐌹𐍃|t=end}}; also {{cog|ga|éadan|t=end; front}}, {{cog|gv|eddin|t=face; front}}, {{cog|gd|aodann|t=face; hillside}}, {{cog|la|antiae|t=forelock}}, {{cog|grc|ἀντίος|t=opposite}}, {{cog|sq|anë|t=brink; edge; facet; side}}, {{cog|lv|no|t=for; from}}, {{cog|lt|nuo|t=for; from}}, {{cog|be,bg,mk,ru,uk|на|t=on}}, {{cog|cs,csb,dsb,pl,sk,sl|na|t=on}}, {{cog|sh|на}}, {{m|sh|na|t=on}}, {{cog|xcl|ընդ|t=in the place, instead of}}, {{cog|peo|𐎠𐎲𐎡𐎹|tr=abiy|t=against; towards; upon}}, {{cog|xto|ānt|t=in front}}, {{cog|txb|ānte|t=in front of}}, {{cog|sa|अन्त|t=boundary; border, edge; end, termination}}.  More at {{m|en|and}} and {{m|en|anti-}}.
{{col-bottom}}

The verb is from {{der|en|enm|enden}}, {{m|enm|endien}}, from {{der|en|ang|endian||to end, to make an end of, complete, finish, abolish, destroy, come to an end, die}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*andijōną||to finish, end}}, denominative from {{m|gem-pro|*andijaz}}.
